Hullmods

Spoiler
Supercharger Reactor
increase energy weapons damage
Stabilized Ballistic Emplacements
increase ballistic weapons range, similar to advanced optics
Fortified Shields
Reduces the amount of damage taken by shields by 25 percent, but reduce shield's arc by 40 percent. Cumulative with Hardened Shields (cost less than Hardened Shields)
Improved Automation
reduces crew requirements by 30%
Additional Crew Quarters
increase crew capacity by 15%
Reinforced Barrels
increase projectile speed by 50%

Mercenary [pink]
spawn random ships
Shipbuilders Guild [purple]
they trade with every station and sell any type of ships(mods included), some weapons, and buy excess fuel and supllies

aiDescription: Adds new missiles, ballistic and energy weapons, ships, hullmods, and factions. Includes new ship types like the Aurora Mk2 heavy cruiser and Bolter cruiser carrier. Adds hullmods such as Supercharger Reactor and Stabilized Ballistic Emplacements. Introduces Mercenary and Shipbuilders Guild factions.
